paragraphs.text: Unesh is a leader of Sphinxes on Amonkhet .

Unesh is the sovereign of the Criosphinx of Amonkhet. The Criosphinx is one of the rare few sphinxes that have the heads of a ram instead of a humanlike face, like other sphinxes. He was placed under the same curse by Nicol Bolas as all of his kind, being utterly incapable of communication, verbal or nonverbal, even written. His Sphinxes are less enigmatic and more aggressive, being driven by the hatred of Bolas due to his curse. They are known to actively attack angels , demons , and other agents of Bolas they encounter in the desert. They stay far from Naktamun and care little for its people.
